The subject deadpans at the camera while presenting vibrant red grooming bottles, handfuls of diamonds, or nautical props[cite: 1]. Include bold, glossy retro magazine ad layout styling with crisp commercial typography banners reading 'SMELL LIKE A MAN, MAN.'[cite: 1] IDENTITY PRESERVATION: Maintain the subject's exact facial feature proportions, ethnic identity, distinctive traits, and expressions while infusing them with suave, larger-than-life charisma. COMPOSITION: Frame as a punchy, mid-to-wide commercial print ad shot with saturated colors, sharp studio-quality daylight illumination, and dynamic spatial depth[cite: 1].
